title: Gaza ceasefire — January 2025 agreement
description: The first 2025 Gaza ceasefire took effect at 11:15 on 19 January. Its 42-day first phase concluded at midnight on 1 March.

title: Liberation Day reciprocal tariffs announced
description: Executive Order 14257 established a 10% baseline reciprocal tariff, effective 5 April, and Annex I country-specific rates, initially due to take effect on 9 April.

title: Section 232 automobile tariff took effect
description: A 25% Section 232 tariff took effect for covered passenger vehicles and light trucks.

title: Country-specific reciprocal tariffs paused
description: Executive Order 14266 held most country-specific reciprocal rates at 10% while China was treated separately. Later extensions carried the pause through 6 August.

title: US first-quarter GDP advance estimate reported a 0.3% contraction
description: BEA's advance vintage reported real GDP down 0.3% at a seasonally adjusted annual rate. The value was subsequently superseded and is retained here as a dated release vintage.

title: Section 232 automobile-parts tariff took effect
description: The 25% Section 232 tariff took effect for covered automobile parts.

title: US–China Geneva tariff truce took effect
description: Executive Order 14298 implemented the Geneva arrangement and reduced the reciprocal tariff on covered Chinese goods for an initial 90-day period.

title: ECB lowered the deposit-facility rate to 2.00%
description: The Governing Council lowered its three key interest rates by 25 basis points. The 2.00% deposit-facility rate became effective on 11 June.

title: Reciprocal-tariff pause deadline extended
description: Executive Order 14316 extended the pause before the revised country-specific reciprocal rates resumed.

title: Revised country-specific reciprocal tariffs resumed
description: The revised country schedule in Executive Order 14326 took effect. Its text included the European Union's 15% all-in ceiling formula.

title: US–China tariff truce extended for 90 days
description: Executive Order 14334 extended the suspension of heightened reciprocal tariffs on China for a further 90 days.

title: US–Japan tariff agreement implemented
description: Executive Order 14345 implemented the bilateral agreement, including a 15% all-in tariff treatment for covered Japanese goods during the IEEPA era.

title: Bilateral trade-agreement implementation framework established
description: Executive Order 14346 established a framework for implementing trade and security agreements with trading partners.

title: Federal Reserve lowered its target range to 4.00%–4.25%
description: The FOMC lowered the federal funds target range by 25 basis points.

title: US federal government shutdown
description: The FY2026 funding gap began on 1 October and ended when funding legislation was signed on 12 November, a period of about 43 days.

title: Gaza ceasefire — October 2025 agreement
description: Implementation of the later 2025 Gaza ceasefire commenced on 10 October, following agreement and signature of implementation steps on 9 October.

title: Federal Reserve lowered its target range to 3.75%–4.00%
description: The FOMC lowered the federal funds target range by 25 basis points.

title: China fentanyl-related tariff reduced to 10%
description: Executive Order 14357 reduced the additional tariff addressing the synthetic-opioid supply chain from 20% to 10%. The action ended with the IEEPA termination.

title: China reciprocal-tariff suspension extended
description: Executive Order 14358 extended the reciprocal-tariff suspension, nominally through 10 November 2026. The later IEEPA termination ended the action on 24 February 2026.

title: Agricultural products carved out of reciprocal tariffs
description: Executive Order 14360 modified the scope of reciprocal tariffs by removing specified agricultural products. The IEEPA programme later ended.

title: Brazil tariff scope reduced
description: Executive Order 14361 reduced the scope of additional duties applied to Brazil. The IEEPA programme later ended.

title: Japan third-quarter GDP second preliminary estimate released
description: The second preliminary vintage reported real GDP down 0.6% quarter on quarter, seasonally adjusted, or 2.3% at a seasonally adjusted annual rate.

title: Federal Reserve lowered its target range to 3.50%–3.75%
description: The FOMC lowered the federal funds target range by 25 basis points.

title: Iran protests began
description: Protests began on 28 December 2025. Primary reporting supports a December 2025–January 2026 period, but no exact end date is assigned.

title: US military conducted targeted strikes in Venezuela
description: The US Armed Forces conducted targeted and limited strikes within Venezuela in connection with an operation to apprehend and transport Nicolás Maduro and Cilia Flores to the United States.

title: Narrow Section 232 semiconductor tariff took effect
description: A 25% tariff took effect for a narrow set of performance-defined products in HTS 8471.50, 8471.80 and 8473.30, subject to broad carve-outs.

title: Supreme Court ruled on IEEPA tariffs
description: The Supreme Court held that IEEPA did not authorize the tariff actions at issue. The administration issued a separate termination order the same day, effective 24 February.

title: IEEPA tariff actions terminated
description: Executive Order 14389 ended reciprocal and fentanyl/border tariffs imposed under IEEPA. Section 232 and Section 301 duties were expressly unaffected.

title: Section 122 global surcharge took effect
description: Proclamation 11012 imposed a 15% global import surcharge under Section 122, subject to the statute's 150-day limit.

title: Strait of Hormuz effectively closed
description: The July 2026 EIA outlook records that the strait had been effectively closed since 28 February, materially disrupting oil flows. A reopening memorandum followed on 18 June.

title: QatarEnergy halted LNG production
description: QatarEnergy halted LNG and associated-product production at Ras Laffan and Mesaieed after attacks on operating facilities.

title: Section 232 steel and aluminium tariffs increased to 50%
description: The Section 232 rate on covered steel, aluminium and derivatives increased from 25% to 50%; the United Kingdom remained at 25%.

title: US and Iran signed Strait of Hormuz reopening memorandum
description: The United States and Iran signed a memorandum to end the conflict and open the strait. Subsequent vessel data show that the reopening was not durable.

title: Strait of Hormuz disruption resumed
description: A renewed closure was reported around 11 July. IMF PortWatch data subsequently showed only 0–8 daily transits against a pre-conflict baseline near 63, so the date is presented as approximate.

title: Section 122 surcharge era ended
description: The statutory 150-day Section 122 surcharge period expired as the first tranche of the new Section 301 schedule took effect.

title: Section 301 forced-labour tariff schedule began
description: Part A of the Section 301 schedule took effect, replacing the expired Section 122 layer for investigated economies.

title: Second Section 301 tariff tranche took effect
description: Part B of the Section 301 schedule took effect, completing the two-stage transition to the current general tariff regime.

title: Section 232 pharmaceutical tariffs began for Annex III companies
description: Proclamation 11020's tiered pharmaceutical tariffs took effect for companies listed in Annex III. Generic and biosimilar medicines were excluded under the controlling Annex IV code list.

title: Section 232 pharmaceutical tariffs scheduled to broaden
description: The pharmaceutical tariff schedule is due to extend beyond the Annex III company group. This is a scheduled future event as of the catalog's 12 August 2026 cutoff.
